harness_review.factor_registry: All eight entries independently reconstruct the declared mixed-VALID-only minimum among q512 W8 host-float-latent PE/G points; exact metadata match, six PE and two G. No SCORE-based winner selection was performed in this review.
harness_review.scope: B canonicalizes only the same pilot operators, C uses local maps, D is one fixed VALID-selected mixed factor arm. Other source GGUF functions and live alpha/slot order remain. D is not an exhaustive comparison of all G/PE deployments.
harness_review.epoch_and_worker_closure: The frozen harness specifies owned post-execution snapshots, context/run/arm/subrun plus decode/microbatch/layer keys, exact IDs/shape/strides, single consumption including zero masks, and fail-closed replies. Actual numerical worker/process RN/MXCSR/FTZ/DAZ requirements are explicit.
harness_review.fresh_subruns: Source replay and independent free-run need their own fresh prefix/KV subruns with identical frozen tokenizer/BOS/truncation IDs across arms. Root incorporated the requested closure before freezing.
harness_review.approval_scope: Conceptual approval for unique code/build/synthetic only. Real model, prompt and fitted-payload execution still requires independent source/build/synthetic approval and phase release. Hook/IPC/duplicate-compute timings are not compressed deployment measurements.

PG19_quality_review.prospective_validity: The adopted unguarded eight-operator local configuration, reference, selected books, window, margin, two-model family and stopping rule are fixed before book payload/outcome access. This can support a prospective bounded configuration-quality failure without retroactively changing Stage0/1 or claiming all guarded variants impossible.
PG19_quality_review.window_and_scoring: Generation/size/MD5-pinned sixteen books, deterministic normalized-Unicode midpoint-to-LF suffix, joint model-specific tokenization, context IDs0..255 and targets256..511 using logits255..510 are coherent. All arms use the same per-model target IDs and their own affected state. Missing/short books remain in the screen and make it inconclusive rather than being substituted.
PG19_quality_review.metric: Mean paired 256-token book NLL deltas and exp(mean delta)-1 correctly define a custom subset-token PPL ratio. This is neither full PG19 word-PPL nor a cross-tokenizer quality comparison.
PG19_quality_review.margin: log(1.02)=0.01980262729617973 is an explicit practical two-percent relative-PPL screen budget chosen before outcomes, not a universal research quality standard.
PG19_quality_review.inference: Sixteen paired books with shared resamples across two primary model endpoints and the declared simultaneous approximate bands are appropriate for this bounded screen. Small-sample bootstrap limits remain. Nonfinite/missing or nonliteral zero-SD endpoints make the whole primary family inconclusive; literal sample identity is separately descriptive and must not become a zero-width population guarantee.
PG19_quality_review.secondary: Source/B transformation loss and fixed D-factor comparisons remain reported secondary diagnostics; no PG-based arm, factor family, gauge, guard, window or threshold selection.
PG19_quality_review.bounded_failure: A valid tooling-closed lower simultaneous C-minus-B band above the fixed margin for either model can reject the joint adopted cross-model pilot requirement. Name the failing model and reference budget. A failure may coexist with a different result versus source GGUF and does not establish that the model is universally unusable.
PG19_quality_review.round_progress: After Root/critic result adjudication this prospective failure is a legitimate bounded attempted-configuration result for Round2. It need not prove every alternative impossible. No failure is assigned now; a pass only supports expansion and is not publication success.

coverage_and_implementation_reporting: Record per-arm/per-operator natural selections and actual substituted slots, separated into conditioning prefix and scored-predecessor positions. Counts from unused final logits must not inflate scored exposure.

If no intervention occurs anywhere, C and B should be identical under the verified insertion path; disagreement is a tooling issue. Unexposed operators cannot receive individual quality claims. A genuine regression from exposed operators can still reject the configured set.
All source/copy/canonical numerical gates must pass before quality classification. Failures of those gates are invalid tooling attempts, not scientific failures.

Preserve payload bytes, content/token/window hashes and all sixteen per-book values after separately authorized acquisition. No book payload, TEST data or candidate execution was accessed in this review.
